courthouses.name: Fairfield Courthouse — Hall of Justice
courthouses.hours: Courthouse 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.; clerk's offices drop-in 8:00–11:30 a.m. or by appointment 8:00 a.m.–3:00 p.m. Criminal clerk phone line Mon–Fri 8–12 & 1–3.
courthouses.note: Fairfield Criminal and Traffic clerk's offices are here (Criminal (707) 207-7380; Traffic (707) 207-7360); also Juvenile (707) 207-7345, Family Law, Probate. Courtrooms here per the criminal setting guide: Dept 11 (Presiding Judge; Drug Court / Parole Re-Entry / Mental Health Diversion / Veterans calendars) and Dept 21 (Commissioner; jail arraignments, traffic arraignments/trials, adult truancy). Criminal email: criminaldivision@solano.courts.ca.gov. Assignments rotate — confirm your department.

programs.name: Adult Drug Court
programs.summary: Court supervision, case management and long-term treatment instead of jail for Solano residents with a substantial substance-use problem whose felony/misdemeanor charges or probation violations are connected to drugs or alcohol. Must be probation-eligible; acceptance only post-conviction or post-finding of a probation violation (referrals may come before plea from judge, attorney or probation). Not for 1170(h) split sentence only, PRCS or parole.
programs.todo: Phone is the Fairfield ADC case manager; Vallejo case manager (707) 561-7948

programs.name: Mental Health Court / Mental Health Diversion
programs.summary: Non-adversarial court for Solano residents charged with a felony or misdemeanor who meet DSM criteria for a serious mental illness with severe functional impairment and voluntarily agree to treatment with a licensed provider. Excludes murder, voluntary manslaughter, rape, registrable sex offenses and VC 23152(a)/(b) DUI. Defendant carries the burden of showing eligibility; intake forms for PD/Alternate PD on the page.

programs.name: Veterans Treatment Court
programs.summary: For Solano-resident veterans with a qualifying service-related diagnosis whose case falls under PC 1170.9 and who are probation-eligible. Referral pre-plea, post-plea or on a probation violation; VA Veterans Justice Outreach verifies service; referral packet and both release forms required.
programs.todo: Phone is the Fairfield probation officer listed; Vallejo PO (707) 553-5531; no case-manager phone listed

programs.name: Parole Reentry Court
programs.summary: For Solano-supervised parolees with substance use and/or mental illness who violated parole; intensive treatment as an alternative to jail/prison. Excludes non-revocable parole, <1 year remaining, current serious/violent charge, or people on county probation. Referral by judge, attorney or parole agent.
